_readme: Shop products. Every product marked "placeholder": true shows a 'Sample price' tag on the site until the studio confirms it: set the real prices, then set placeholder to false or delete the line. 'photo' is the sample photograph shown in the product mock-up (a path under /public/photos). To show a real product photograph instead, add "image": "/shop/your-file.webp" and put the file in /public/shop. Prices are in rupees, inclusive of GST unless the note says otherwise.
